text:
Avery: Heads-up — proposing a cross-region retention schedule for security telemetry. Idea: 90 days in hot storage (us-west-2 / eu-west-1) for incident triage, then transition to cold (365 days) for compliance.
Avery: Also want to expose scrubbed "analyst views" to a small analyst role for forensics, not raw logs. Need RBAC change + a KMS gating model for access to decrypted slices.
Ravi: Quick Q — for the cold tier are we using the existing account CMK or a region-specific key? cross-region key wrapping has implications for key policies. :thinking_face:
Marta: We should use region-bound CMKs to keep key material regionalized. That avoids multi-region key grants for contractors. I'll draft an RBAC change: "security:analyst_scrubbed_view" with read-only and no export.
Theo: How will SIEM exports behave? If we transition to cold, will search still surface results in the SIEM UI or do we need rehydration?
Avery: Good point. Plan: SIEM stays indexed for 90d (hot). After transition, only metadata and pointers remain in the SIEM index; full event retrieval requires a rehydrate request to the cold store (automated but timebound).
Marta: Filing ticket now: SEC-6123 for RBAC + key policy updates. I'll attach the role JSON and TTL rules. We should limit analyst access to 30-day timebound grants per incident.
sec-bot: PR #4321 merged — retention-policy.yaml updated in infra. (deployed to staging) :white_check_mark:
Ravi: Can you paste the retention snippet here so infra can validate the key policy mapping?
Avery: Sure — minimal snippet for infra review:
```yaml
retention:
  hot_days: 90
  cold_days: 365
  rehydrate_window_days: 7
kms:
  region_policy: region-bound
  access_mode: envelope
rbac_roles:
  - name: security:analyst_scrubbed_view
    entitlements: [read_scrubbed, search_metadata]
    max_grant_ttl_days: 30
```
Oncall-SRE: If we enable region-bound CMKs we need a rollback plan for cross-account debugging. Suggest a short-lived emergency-unseal process (ticket + 2-person approval).
Marta: Agreed. I'll add the emergency-unseal flow to the runbook (SEC-RUNBOOK-8) and include approval templates.
Theo: Forensics: will the scrubbed view remove IPs/emails? Need clarity on what is considered scrubbed vs minimal context.
Avery: Scrubbed = tokenized PII (ip -> ip:hash, email -> domain only) + remove full request bodies. We keep enough context for triage (service, endpoint, status codes, timestamps).
Ravi: Acknowledged. I'll update key policy draft to include explicit principal whitelists and deny statements for export actions.
Marta: I'll request a staged rollout: staging -> canary org -> full rollout. Will coordinate with legal for the retention windows.
Avery: Thanks — if no objections I’ll move SEC-6123 to review and run the terraform plan against staging tomorrow morning. :rocket:
Ravi: :+1:
Oncall-SRE: Leaving a note in the oncall channel about potential rehydration latency during the rollout window.
